rules.claim: When a lot in the PL Public Lands District abuts a lot in a single-family or two-family residential district, landscape buffers per Chapter 21A.48 are required.
rules.source_quote: G. Landscape Buffers: When a lot in the PL Public Lands District abuts a lot in a single-family or two-family residential district, landscape buffers, in accordance with the requirements of Chapter 21A.48, shall be required.
rules.title: Landscape buffer abutting single/two-family residential

rules.claim: Row house: residential on all stories; live/work units permitted on the ground level only.
rules.source_quote: Uses Per Story | Residential on all stories; live/work units permitted on the ground level. (Table C.1, 21A.25.070)
rules.title: Row house uses per story

rules.claim: Maximum 125 feet. Buildings in excess of 85 feet require design review per Chapter 21A.59.
rules.source_quote: Height | Maximum: 125 feet. Design Review: Buildings in excess of 85 feet require design review in accordance with Chapter 21A.59. (Table C.2, 21A.25.070)
rules.title: Maximum height; design review threshold

caveats: Bonus-area membership (in_height_bonus_area) must be determined geometrically against the two bounded areas; v1 takes it as a supplied fact.
rules.claim: Up to 150 ft in two bounded areas via Chapter 21A.59 design review, subject to >=10% ground-level open space with outdoor active space AND (100% enhanced active use per 21A.37.050.A.2 OR a midblock walkway >=20 ft wide).
rules.source_quote: Additional Height | Properties bounded by (1) 400 South to the I-15 West Temple Off-ramp and 300 West to I-15, or (2) McClelland Street along the eastern boundary of Fairmont Park to 1300 East and 2100 South to I-80, may be allowed up to 150 feet in height through the design review process of Chapter 21A.59, subject to: 1. At least 10% of the lot shall be open space area at the ground level with an outdoor active space... 2. The development includes at least one of: 100% enhanced active use within the required ground floor use area or a midblock walkway at least 20 feet wide. (Table C.2, 21A.25.070)
rules.title: Additional height to 150 ft in bonus areas

caveats: 1700 South and 2100 South minima apply only on the West Temple to I-15 segments; v1 requires the segment flag (front_street_within_listed_segment) and returns UNKNOWN when the street is segment-limited but the segment is unknown and the setback is below 10 ft.
rules.claim: Minimum: none, except 5 ft on North Temple and 10 ft on 300 West, 400 South, 1700 South (West Temple to I-15), 2100 South (West Temple to I-15). Maximum: 20 ft.
rules.source_quote: Front and Corner Side Yard Setback | Minimum: None, except as listed below: 1. 5 feet on North Temple. 2. 10 feet, on the following streets: a. 300 West b. 400 South c. 1700 South, from West Temple to I-15 d. 2100 South, from West Temple to I-15. Maximum: 20 feet. (Table C.2, 21A.25.070)
rules.title: Front and corner side yard setbacks

rules.claim: Minimum: none. When the interior side yard abuts an R-1, R-2, FR, SR, FB-UN1, RMF-30, RMF-35, MU-2, or MU-3 zone, the minimum is 10 ft.
rules.source_quote: Interior Side Yard | Minimum: None. When the interior side yard abuts an R-1, R-2, FR, SR, FB-UN1, RMF-30, RMF-35, MU-2, or MU-3 zone, the minimum is 10 feet. (Table C.2, 21A.25.070)
rules.title: Interior side yard setback

rules.claim: Minimum: none. When the rear yard abuts an R-1, R-2, FR, SR, FB-UN1, RMF-30, RMF-35, MU-2, or MU-3 zone along the rear lot line, the minimum is 20 ft.
rules.source_quote: Rear Yard | Minimum: None. When the rear yard abuts an R-1, R-2, FR, SR, FB-UN1, RMF-30, RMF-35, MU-2, or MU-3 zone along the rear lot line, the minimum is 20 feet. (Table C.2, 21A.25.070)
rules.title: Rear yard setback

broadened_by_sweep.sweep_quote: SWEEP RESULT — code-wide absence sweep complete: no minimum lot area or lot width applies to MU-5, MU-6, or MU-11 anywhere in Title 21A (2026 S-21). Checked §21A.25.010 in full plus exact-phrase search of all of Title 21A; Title 20 defers to the district, which states none. MU-5-16, MU-6-16, MU-11-11 now read 'no minimum' without qualification. Note: MU-2/MU-3 (not our districts) have a maximum lot width cap of 110 ft — irrelevant here.

caveats: Superseded history: a 2012 Planning Commission draft's 50-ft/30-ft width floor never entered current law (superseded by the Ord. 73-23, 2023 Title 20 rewrite); it must not be reintroduced from stale sources.
rules.claim: No minimum lot area or minimum lot width applies to the MU-11 Mixed Use 11 District anywhere in Title 21A (2026 S-21). No minimum is stated in 21A.25.070 (MU-11 district standards) or 21A.25.010 (MU general provisions), and Title 20 (Subdivisions) imposes no independent minimum: 20.26.090.C expressly requires only compliance with the minimum lot size and lot width 'required within the applicable zoning district or overlay district in Title 21A,' which for MU-11 is none.
